name: Question 10
problem:
For the universal set $U,$ given by

$$
U={2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10},
$$

find the truth set of $P(x)⇔Q(x)$ for the following predicates: 

- $P(x):$ $x$ is composite

- $Q(x):$ $10$ is divisible by $x$
worked_solution:
Since we have that

$$
P(x)⇔Q(x)≡(P(x)∧Q(x))∨(¬P(x)∧¬Q(x)),
$$

the corresponding truth set can be found as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{T}_{P⇔Q}=({T}_{P}\cap {T}_{Q})\cup ({\overset{―}{T}}_{P}\cap {\overset{―}{T}}_{Q})\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that:

- The truth set of $P(x)$ is 

$$
{T}_{P}={4,6,8,9,10}
$$

and its complement is

$$
{\overset{―}{T}}_{P}={2,3,5,7}.
$$

- The truth set of $Q(x)$ is 

$$
{T}_{Q}={2,5,10}
$$

 
and its complement is

$$
{\overset{―}{T}}_{Q}={3,4,6,7,8,9}.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{T}_{P}\cap {T}_{Q} & ={4,6,8,9,10}\cap {2,5,10} \\  & ={10} \\ {\overset{―}{T}}_{P}\cap {\overset{―}{T}}_{Q} & ={2,3,5,7}\cap {3,4,6,7,8,9} \\  & ={3,7} \\ {T}_{P⇔Q} & =({T}_{P}\cap {T}_{Q})\cup ({\overset{―}{T}}_{P}\cap {\overset{―}{T}}_{Q}) \\  & ={10}\cup {3,7} \\  & ={3,7,10}.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 10
?

For the universal set U, given by

U={2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10},

find the truth set of P(x)⇔Q(x) for the following predicates:

  • P(x): x is composite

  • Q(x): 10 is divisible by x

a
{3,7,10}
b
{10}
c
{2,5,10}
d
{4,6,8,9,10}
e
{3,4,6,7,8,9}
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Since we have that

P(x)⇔Q(x)≡(P(x)∧Q(x))∨(¬P(x)∧¬Q(x)), the corresponding truth set can be found as follows:

TP⇔Q=(TP∩TQ)∪(T―P∩T―Q)

Notice that:

  • The truth set of P(x) is TP={4,6,8,9,10} and its complement is T―P={2,3,5,7}.

  • The truth set of Q(x) is TQ={2,5,10} and its complement is T―Q={3,4,6,7,8,9}.

Therefore, we have

TP∩TQ={4,6,8,9,10}∩{2,5,10}={10}T―P∩T―Q={2,3,5,7}∩{3,4,6,7,8,9}={3,7}TP⇔Q=(TP∩TQ)∪(T―P∩T―Q)={10}∪{3,7}={3,7,10}.
